name: Jennifer Coppola
story: Jennifer Coppola’s LINZ career profile records work as a Nautical Cartographer and later Hydrographic Surveyor. She described nautical chart production as specialised GIS and later undertook postgraduate geospatial study. Her record connects chart production, surveying and formal GIS education.
LINZ names Jennifer Coppola in its geospatial virtual field-trip record: Nautical Cartographer, LINZ, 2016 VFT.
A LINZ geospatial student or graduate profile records Jennifer Coppola: LINZ Hydrographic Surveyor; formerly Nautical Cartographer; Massey geospatial study.
